reason: Phase 3 establishes the persisted selection contract (an opt-out is an intent; a restored identity is validated against the live registry; the selected configuration drives every derived view; engagement is a typed outcome), the migration pattern that makes a session-entry payload change free, the fail-open lesson that a preprocessing heuristic must not be allowed to silently disable a guard, and the atomic check-then-write rule.
